description: Two-component acrylic modified cementitious, flexible waterproof coating easy to apply for waterproofing balconies, terraces, and bathrooms
whereToUse: Mapelastic Easy is used for waterproofing wet areas, balconies, and terraces.
Waterproofing bathrooms, showers, balconies, terraces etc., before laying ceramic tiles
Waterproofing plasterboard, render or cementitious surfaces
notFor: Do not apply Mapelastic Easy at temperatures lower than +8°C
Do not add cement, aggregates, or water to Mapelastic Easy
Protect from rain and water spillages for the first 24 hours after application
Do not apply on lightweight substrates
Do not apply on cementitious substrates not sufficiently cured

standards.value: in compliance with the requirements of EN 14891

technicalData.label: Mixing ratio
technicalData.value: component A : component B = 3 : 1 (one 18 kg bag of component A with an 6 kg can of component B)

technicalData.label: Thickness applied
technicalData.value: Final thickness at least 2 mm (See product application section)

technicalData.label: Application temperature range
technicalData.value: Surrounding and substrate temperature from +8°C to +40°C

technicalData.label: Impermeability to water, expressed as capillary absorption
Mapelastic Easy must be applied in
technicalData.value: at least two coats by brush, trowel or with a roller within 60 minutes of it being mixed, to give a final required thickness

technicalData.label: After applying Mapelastic Easy
technicalData.value: wait at least 5 days for curing before laying ceramic tiles

consumption.basis: application by trowel or roller, per m² per mm of thickness
consumption.quote: Application by trowel or roller: Approx. 1.9 kg/m² per mm of thickness.

mixing: component A : component B = 3 : 1 (one 18 kg bag of component A with an 6 kg can of component B)
packaging: Mapelastic Easy available in 24 kg kits. ▪ Component A: 18 kg bags ▪ Component B: 6 kg jerrycans
storage: Mapelastic Easy component A may be stored for up to 12 months when contained in its original sealed packaging in a dry place. Mapelastic Easy component B may be stored for up to 24 months. Store Mapelastic Easy in a dry place and at a temperature of at least +5°C.
notes: The one consumption figure (approx. 1.9 kg/m² per mm of thickness) is stated for trowel or roller; brush is also a listed application method but has no figure, and no spray figure is given. The sheet adds: 'the consumption figures indicated are for a seamless film on a flat surface and are higher if applied on uneven substrates'. Thickness is worded two ways: 'at a thickness of approximately 2 mm' in the characteristics and 'Final thickness at least 2 mm' in the application table; the application text itself only says 'a final required thickness'. Working time is inconsistent: the table gives pot life 'approx. 2 hours (at +20°C)' but the application text says it must be applied 'within 60 minutes of it being mixed'. No waiting time between coats is given. The 5-day wait before tiling may be longer in cold conditions or reduced in good weather per the sheet. Component B is called a '6 kg can' in the mixing ratio row and '6 kg jerrycans' under packaging. EN 14891 compliance is stated without a class designation. Final performance values are stated at 2.0 mm applied thickness. This is the UAE edition of the sheet.
